facts.text: I am training for another marathon.
I completed my first marathon 6 months after turning 30.
My first marathon was an incredible experience.
My current marathon finish time is around 4 hours 15 minutes.
I want to shave off at least 15 minutes from my next marathon finish time.
I plan to incorporate strength training into my training routine.
I have been inconsistent with stretching after my runs.
I often forget to stretch after my runs.
I will make stretching a priority from now on.
I will schedule stretching into my daily planner as a non-negotiable part of my post-run routine.
I will try to find a stretching buddy who is a friend or family member and also into running.
I will track my progress in my running log to see how consistent I am being.
